differences.text: The list is an inner <ol role="list"> in the shadow root and the crumbs are slotted custom elements whose hosts are list items (ElementInternals), as tct-list does (LIST-01); a host aria-label is delegated to the inner <nav>. The trail resolves the automatic current page and the collapsed set from its children and tells them through context; upstream did it with a DOM effect in each item.

`max-items` is an addition. With more items than max-items the first item and the last max-items - 1 stay and the ones between fold into one ellipsis button that opens a menu of the hidden crumbs (links keep navigating, actions keep their click). Upstream has no built-in collapse; the same shape is possible there with a menu crumb.

Tecton breadcrumbs sit directly on the page with no container: ancestors are the secondary text colour, the current crumb the primary text colour and one step heavier, separators are decorative and the built-in slash mirrors in right-to-left. Links underline on hover, the underline being the only affordance.

core.breadcrumbs.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] (list semantics on the item hosts, nav in the shadow root) [mwg:accessibility] (breadcrumb pattern, aria-current="page") [mwg:resilient-context-menus-and-nested-dropdowns] (the crumb menus are the shared dropdown menu).

differences.text: The item renders its own separator (hidden on the first item with :host(:first-child)) as upstream does. A crumb with neither `href` nor `menu` is a <button> that fires click; upstream rendered a plain span for that shape unless an onClick was given, which a custom element cannot detect. To show static text mark the crumb `current`.

Menu rows are the shared dropdown menu items: `BreadcrumbMenuItem` and its siblings are `tct-dropdown-menu-item`, `-checkbox-item`, `-radio-group` and `-sub-menu` in slot="menu", or data rows in `menu`. Data rows have no `href`; a row's onClick navigates.
Automatic current page: the trail marks the last item when no item is explicitly current, on the crumb's own link, button or text (aria-current="page"), never on the list item.
